label: Magazine
purpose: Clippings for a story several outlets reported: white cards with hairline ink borders on the paper ground, Petrona headlines, Literata text and Plex Mono labels. Blueprint blue only for the kicker and one rule; the statement keeps the blue and ink grounds.

background.source: --surface-reading in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; the white of the top card, where every inner slide's words sit.

surface.source: --surface-page in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; the paper ground the cards lie on, one the light logotype is approved for.

surface-strong.source: --surface-subtle in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; the cards under the top one, a shade darker than the paper.

foreground.source: --text-primary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; headlines, card borders, the masthead bar and the ink statement ground.

muted.source: --text-secondary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; body text, credits and plate hairlines.

accent.source: Blueprint blue: --accent-primary and the DNESK colour of the logotype; the kicker, the type post's rule and the statement ground.

secondary.source: The Ai colour of the logotype (brandAi in lib/og-theme.ts).

headline.source: A display serif with a calligraphic stress, set at 800 for headlines: the magazine page's voice, distinct from the editorial grotesque. Every committed weight passes the Czech alphabet gate.

body.source: A text serif drawn for long reading on screens, for paragraphs and sources; Czech-complete in every committed weight.

mono.source: BRAND_SYSTEM.md: dates, issue identifiers, source ids, tags, captions and measured values.
